articles.summary: CEDAR PARK, Texas, Nov. 19, 2019 /PRNewswire/ — Firefly Aerospace (Firefly) announced this past summer the Dedicated Research and Education Accelerator Mission (DREAM), a global competition to host academic and educational payloads as rideshare participants on the inaugural flight of the Firefly Alpha launch vehicle. Today we are happy to announce the payloads selected to fly on...
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Announces DREAM Payload Participants
